note: the actually decoded owner row, one retained client decode per case, fed to the original human projection methods. synced and optimistic lock values are recorded separately at declared UI test clocks; the draw track is one retained instance per lifecycle with a declared render delay; the cooldown helper carries the prior actual helper state; statsOf and ChampionCombatHud.update are the client's own code paths.
provenance: actual-producer decoded owner + original client methods

rig.lockDisplay: packages/client/src/render/targeting.ts class LockDisplay: note() on the frame whose ordinary target/move/stop message was queued by the owner, shown() every frame with the decoded attackTarget at the declared UI clock, boundary samples at the declared offsets
rig.drawTrack: packages/client/src/render/FighterArt.ts class DrawTrack: one retained instance per case, track(decoded drawStartedAt, declared renderT, patchT)
rig.cooldown: packages/client/src/ui/weaponBar.ts isExtension/nextCooldown, called only on a decoded readyAt change and carrying the prior helper state
rig.statsOf: packages/client/src/ui/buildHud.ts statsOf (which calls the original buildGains) over the decoded row
rig.championCombat: packages/client/src/ui/championCombatHud.ts ChampionCombatHud.update (which calls the original championCombatModel) with the decoded state and row; the rendered row text is read back from the stub nodes
rig.noDomClaim: no real DOM, layout, painting, Phaser or GPU work happens here
